response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, highly experienced software craftsman with strong full-stack, low-latency systems, and DevOps background, plus relevant GIS/geospatial project experience via GISCollective. However, his recent professional work is overwhelmingly in TypeScript/Node.js/JavaScript, with C++ experience limited to a brief stint over a decade ago and no evidence of Rust or modern C++ in production. The role explicitly requires strong current C++ or Rust expertise for a routing/navigation tiling pipeline, which is not reflected in his recent skill set or listed technologies.
strengths: Extensive geospatial domain exposure through GISCollective and Green Map GIS projects
Strong distributed systems and low-latency experience (Dlang, async I/O, high-throughput microservices at Sociomantic)
Proven adaptability across many languages, stacks, and problem domains with strong CS fundamentals
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ experience (last significant C++ work was 2014-2015) and no Rust experience at all
Current skills list and recent roles are dominated by TypeScript/Node.js/web stack, not systems-level languages
No direct experience with navigation/routing tile generation, real-time traffic integration, or routing-specific QA processes

key_factors.factor: Recent focus on full-stack/web technologies rather than systems programming
